summary: Completed comprehensive testing of VitalTrack Health Vitals SaaS iteration 2. All major features working correctly including premium pricing update, Razorpay integration, dark mode, multilingual support, and shared reports functionality.
passed_tests: GET /api/plans returns premium at ₹499 (updated from ₹599)
Landing page pricing shows ₹499 for Premium plan
Billing page shows all 3 plans with correct prices and upgrade/downgrade buttons
Billing page: free user can see Upgrade button for Standard and Premium
Billing page: Razorpay checkout opens when clicking Upgrade on paid plan
Billing page: downgrade from paid to free works without payment
Settings page: dark mode toggle exists and toggles document.documentElement class
Settings page: language selector with English/Hindi/Telugu options
Settings page: shared reports section with correct plan restrictions
GET /api/translations/hi returns Hindi translations
GET /api/translations/te returns Telugu translations
POST /api/razorpay/create-order returns order_id and amount for standard plan
POST /api/shared-reports creates report with password
GET /api/shared-reports/view/{token} shows password prompt for password-protected reports
POST /api/shared-reports/view/{token} with correct password returns entries
Shared report view page at /shared/{token} renders correctly with error handling
Register flow accessible and form validation working
Admin login with test credentials working
Language switching to Hindi working with UI translation
Backend API authentication and authorization working
